title: Python Backend Developer
description: We are hiring a Python Backend Developer. Minimum 2 years of experience. Required skills: python, django, flask, rest api, sql, git, docker, aws. Responsibilities: built and maintained backend services and APIs; designed database schemas and wrote optimised queries; wrote unit tests and reviewed code; deployed microservices to the cloud; integrated third-party payment and messaging services. Qualification: B.Tech or equivalent.

title: Data Analyst
description: We are hiring a Data Analyst. Minimum 1 years of experience. Required skills: sql, excel, python, pandas, power bi, statistics, data visualization, tableau. Responsibilities: prepared weekly business dashboards; cleaned and analysed sales data; presented insights to managers; automated MIS reports; performed cohort and trend analysis. Qualification: B.Sc or equivalent.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: We are hiring a DevOps Engineer. Minimum 3 years of experience. Required skills: aws, docker, kubernetes, ci/cd, terraform, linux, shell scripting, monitoring. Responsibilities: managed cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines; reduced release time by automating builds; maintained production clusters with high availability; handled incident response and on-call; hardened servers and managed access policies. Qualification: B.E. or equivalent.

title: QA Engineer
description: We are hiring a QA Engineer. Minimum 2 years of experience. Required skills: selenium, manual testing, automation testing, jira, api testing, sql, pytest, agile. Responsibilities: wrote and executed test plans for web releases; logged and tracked defects to closure; built regression suites for every sprint; validated backend data with queries; worked with developers to reproduce production issues. Qualification: B.Tech or equivalent.

title: HR Executive
description: We are hiring a HR Executive. Minimum 2 years of experience. Required skills: recruitment, onboarding, payroll, employee engagement, hrms, labour law, performance management, excel. Responsibilities: managed end-to-end hiring for business teams; coordinated joining formalities for new employees; maintained employee records and attendance; organised engagement and wellness activities; handled employee queries and exit formalities. Qualification: MBA in HR or equivalent.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: We are hiring a Digital Marketing Executive. Minimum 1 years of experience. Required skills: seo, sem, social media marketing, content marketing, google analytics, email marketing, excel, communication. Responsibilities: planned and ran paid campaigns for product launches; grew organic website traffic; managed brand pages and posting calendars; wrote blogs and landing page copy; reported campaign performance to stakeholders. Qualification: BBA or any graduate.
